subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Which Gateway/UI surface should own read-only configured route and ACP binding visibility for the Agents channels panel?
rationale: The request adds a new core Gateway protocol namespace plus a Control UI read model, and current main already has config/CLI binding visibility but no maintainer-confirmed API placement for the UI.

options.title: Approve a normalized binding read model
options.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

options.title: Use existing config data
options.body: Have the UI derive the display from the existing config read surface, accepting tighter coupling to raw config shape while avoiding a new Gateway namespace.

options.title: Defer the UI display
options.body: Keep bindings visible through CLI/config for now and pause the implementation until a broader Control UI routing plan exists.

recommendation.title: Approve a normalized binding read model
recommendation.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history signal for routing/config architecture decisions among the likely owners found.
